title: ImageWidget Envelope
description: Configuration envelope for the IOsense ImageWidget. Emitted by the configurator via onChange() and consumed by the mini-engine + widget renderer. A default image (static PNG/JPG/SVG or a Lottie JSON) is shown until an ordered list of events matches a bound UNS topic against a threshold; the first matching event's image replaces the default, anchored to its alignment.

_id.description: Unique widget instance id. Generated as `iw_<timestamp>` when absent.

timeConfig.description: Optional dashboard-injected time context. Not authored by the ImageWidget configurator; present when the host supplies it.

startTime.description: Epoch ms, or null for rolling windows.

endTime.description: Epoch ms, or null for rolling windows.

width.description: Default rendered width of the widget image in px (0 = auto). Top-level, OUTSIDE uiConfig. Captured from the uploaded asset's natural width; drives the CSS aspect-ratio lock together with height.

height.description: Default rendered height of the widget image in px (0 = auto). Top-level, OUTSIDE uiConfig. Captured from the uploaded asset's natural height.

uiConfig.description: Render configuration for the image widget.

defaultImage.description: Public URL (or base64 data URL) of the default asset — PNG/JPG/SVG raster or a Lottie animation JSON. Shown when no event matches. Empty string means unconfigured (widget renders the 'Image not configured' empty state).

defaultImageSize.description: Size of the default asset in bytes. Persisted so the configurator can re-display the file size on reopen.

linkConfig.description: Click-through navigation for the rendered image. Redirection is suppressed in dashboard edit mode.

enabled.description: When true and url is a valid http(s) URL, the image is wrapped in a link opening in a new tab.

url.description: Destination URL. Only http:// and https:// are honored at render time.

events.description: Ordered list of conditional overlays. Evaluated top-to-bottom; the FIRST event whose bound topic satisfies its operator/value wins, and its image replaces the default anchored to `alignment`. Reorder = priority change.

wrapInCard.description: When true, the image is rendered inside a design-sdk Card wrapper.

bg.description: Optional card background color/token. Empty string = default.

dynamicBindingPathList.description: Bindings extracted from bindable uiConfig fields containing {{topic}}. Built by buildDynamicBindingPathList(uiConfig) before every onChange(). For the ImageWidget the only bindable field is each event's `topic`, so keys look like `events[<i>].topic`.

key.description: Dot/bracket path to the bound uiConfig field (e.g. "events[0].topic").

imageEvent.description: A single conditional overlay: when the bound topic value satisfies operator/value, this asset is shown instead of the default.

label.description: Human-readable event name shown in the configurator list.

image.description: Public URL (or base64 data URL) of the overlay asset — raster or Lottie JSON. When set, it fully replaces the default image (no base/overlay stacking).

imageSize.description: Overlay asset size in bytes. Persisted so the configurator can re-display file size on reopen.

alignment.description: Corner/edge the overlay asset is anchored to within the widget.

width.description: Overlay width in px (0 = auto / natural size). Currently emitted as 0 by the configurator.

height.description: Overlay height in px (0 = auto / natural size). Currently emitted as 0 by the configurator.

topic.description: Bindable — the UNS topic whose resolved value is compared. Authored via UNSPathInput; stored raw as a {{topic}} binding or a resolved UNS value. Surfaces in dynamicBindingPathList as `events[<i>].topic`.

operator.description: Comparison operator applied to (resolvedValue operator value). Numeric operators require both sides to parse as numbers; == also matches on string equality.

value.description: Threshold the resolved topic value is compared against.

frameRangeEnabled.description: Lottie-only. When true, a matched event plays only the [startFrame, endFrame] segment. Forced false for non-JSON assets.

startFrame.description: Lottie start frame of the played segment (0 = unset).

endFrame.description: Lottie end frame of the played segment (0 = unset).
